items.title: Zcash jumps 48% to over $800 as Grayscale spot ETF push adds to ‘next bitcoin’ buzz

items.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days

items.title: Crypto advocates join in suing Illinois over digital asset tax

items.title: MiCA is coming for DeFi vaults, but regulation will be difficult

items.title: Bitget CEO sees Bitcoin near current levels at year-end, doubts US will buy BTC

items.title: Ray Dalio says to buy ‘a bit’ of Bitcoin amid potential debt crisis

items.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
